title: validate() error messages inconsistent: reader uses index, imap uses username
description: reader::Config::validate() emits 'auth.users[0].password appears to be plaintext'; imap::Config::validate() emits 'auth.users['\''alice'\'']: password is not a valid bcrypt hash'. Operators running both services see different error message formats for the same misconfiguration. The reader format (index-based) is strictly less useful because the operator must count entries to find the offending user. A future contributor adding a third service will have to pick one, and will likely pick the wrong one. Both should use the username. Filed because this will generate issue reports from operators who find one format and not the other.
